pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with dark brown pigmentation. Edges exhibit a mix of smooth and slightly jagged pixel gradients, with some patches showing central darkening and lighter peripheral transition zones.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of off-white to cream-colored negative space. Pathways vary in pixel thickness, with distinct wide nodes at the convergence of three or more corridors, creating a non-uniform topological mesh.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, brush-like mane along the neck-to-shoulder transition. The silhouette shows a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile against the background foliage and sky.
